title: Half Marathon Pacing Plan
read:
Good plan. Final checklist for Thursday:

* **Fuel:** one gel at ~mile 5 and ~mile 9 (before the hill), with water.
* **Shoes:** what you've already done long runs in.
* **Warm-up:** 10–12 min easy jog + 3–4 strides.
* **Watch:** set the auto-lap to miles but also watch **effort** on the hill.

Good luck — enjoy it.
running with a friend who's going 1:22. should i go with him at first

**No** — a 1:22 is **6:16/mile**. Running with him for even the first 3 miles would cost you ~40 seconds of "banked" time and a lot more in fatigue. In a half, early overpacing is paid back with interest after mile 9.

Better plan:
* Warm up together, wish him luck at the start, run your own race.
* Find a group around **1:25–1:26** (pacers if the race has them).
* Meet him at the finish.

If you're feeling great at mile 10, you can always go — just not early.
mostly zone 2 base this year, did 2 tempo sessions in the block at like 6:35. is 1:25 realistic

Being honest: it's **ambitious but possible**.

What suggests yes:
* A year of consistent aerobic base (9–11 h/week) builds a big engine; half marathon is ~85% aerobic.
* Tempo sessions at **6:35** feeling controlled suggests threshold pace somewhere around 6:20–6:30.

What suggests caution:
* Only **two** tempo sessions means your legs aren't very practiced at holding race pace for 85 minutes.
* A half is usually run slightly *faster* than tempo pace for well-trained runners, but that assumes tempo work in the legs.

**Suggestion:** start at **6:35–6:38** for the first 3 miles. If at mile 4 it feels controlled, settle into 6:28. If not, hold 6:35 and aim for **~1:26**. Negative-splitting a 1:26 feels much better than blowing up chasing 1:25 and running 1:29.
half marathon thursday oct 15. goal 1:25. what splits. course has a hill around mile 8-9, otherwise flat

**1:25:00** is **6:29/mile** (4:02/km) on average.

With a hill at miles 8–9 on an otherwise flat course, aim for **effort-even**, not pace-even:

| Miles | Target pace | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 6:35–6:40 | Settle in. It'll feel too easy — that's right. |
| 2–7 | 6:26–6:28 | Lock in rhythm. Bank only a few seconds. |
| 8–9 (hill) | 6:40–6:50 | Hold effort, let pace drop. Don't chase. |
| 10 | 6:25 | Use the downhill / recover form. |
| 11–12 | 6:24–6:26 | Start pressing. |
| 13–13.1 | 6:15 or faster | Empty the tank. |

Split at **10K: ~40:10–40:20**. Split at **10 miles: ~65:00**.

Cumulative clock check: mile 7 around **45:25**, mile 9 around **58:40**.
